name: Seima no Tenbin
source:
The holy war between the Kingdom of Eltoria and exotic Mughals has been lasting for many years, exhausting both populations.
Saint girl Riviera could not sit still and went to the battlefield to pray for the dead, but she did not notice an ugly shadow creeping behind her back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
埃尔托利亚王国与异域莫卧儿人之间的圣战持续多年，使双方民众都疲惫不堪。
圣女里维埃拉无法坐视不理，前往战场为死者祈祷，却没有察觉一道丑陋的黑影正从背后悄然逼近。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
